Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 124 s. 2021 NOV 2021 HON. DELFIN D. BULIGON Sangguniang Bayan Member Committee on Appropriations, Ways and Means Office of the Sangguniang Bayan, Municipality of Hingyon, Ifugao Dear SB Member Buligon: This in reference to your letter dated March 11, 2021 relative to Sangguniang Kabataan Resolution No. 2, Series of 2020, which was solely approved by the Sangguniang Kabataan Chairman. Per your letter, Barangay Northem Cababuyan, Hingyon, Ifugao, transmitted to the Sangguniang Bayan for the latter's review the 2021 Annual Budget of the barangay. Upon perusal of the records, however, the Committee on Appropriations, Ways and Means found out that the Sangguniang Kabataan Resolution No. 2, Series of 2020, entitled "Approving the 2021 Sangguniang Kabataan Fund Utilization of Northem Cababuyan, Hingyon, Ifugao in the Amount of Two Hundred Seven Thousand Eight Hundred Eight Pesos and Twenty Centavos (PhP 207,808.20)" was approved solely by the SK Chairman without any members. In relation thereto, as stated in the 3rd Whereas Clause of the subject resolution, the SK Chairman is a lone member of the SK, therefore, the SK Chairman with the supervision of the Sangguniang Barangay members, approved the resolution. Hence, it is the understanding of this Department that the issue to be resolved is regarding the propriety of the subject resolution which was approved without the concurrence of the SK members, thus, approved solely by the SK Chairman. This Department had the occasion to resolve the same issue as embodied in DILG Opinion No. 09, Series of 2020. In gist, we opined that the SK budget shall be deliberated by the SK and approved through a resolution, provided there is a quorum in the SK to transact official business. On the contrary, if there is no quorum, there will be no business that may be transacted which will result to failure to enact appropriations, in which case, re-enacted budget will be in operation. In this case, since the only member of the sangguniang kabataan is SK Chairman Elmer N. Buyuccan, there is clearly no quorum to transact a business and adopt the subject resolution. In effect, Sangguniang Kabataan Resolution No. 2, Series of 2020 is void for being violative of Republic Act No. 10742, otherwise known as the "Sangguniang Kabataan Reform Act of 2015", Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise

known as the "Local Govemment Code of 1991", and other pertinent rules and regulations. Hence, re-enacted budget should have been applied. We see no reason to deviate on our previous opinion, hence, copy of DILG Opinion No. 09, Series of 2020 is hereto attached for reference and guidance. On a final note, for lack of guideline and legal basis/bases in guiding you with this matter, rest assured, the Department will be communicating with the Department of Budget and Management and National Youth Commission the soonest to discuss the herein matter in order to come up with guideline/s that will put a solution to this dilemma. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly you By ority of the ry: MAR Un . DINO cretary for Barangay Affairs Copy Furnished: DIRECTOR ARACELI A. SAN JOSE, CESO "v' Officer-in-Charge, DILG CAR Barangay Center, Baguio City
